Tests stake and destination updates, ordering, limits, identity changes, and removals.

# Purpose
This file is a C test program for the `fd_stake_ci` interface. It builds synthetic stake weight messages and destination lists, then checks that `fd_stake_ci` creates and updates shred destination sets and epoch leader schedules in the correct way. The tests cover startup behavior, epoch transitions, skipped epochs, cancel cases, ordering, destaking, identity changes, vote-based staking, and limit handling for large validator sets.

The file also tests the public update and remove APIs for destination contact data. It verifies that `fd_stake_ci_dest_update` adds or changes contact information for staked and unstaked validators, and that `fd_stake_ci_dest_remove` removes unstaked validators while leaving staked validators in place. The [`main`](<#main>) function runs all test cases after checking a footprint constant, then prints `pass` when all checks succeed.
